answer: Sybil resistance is a cost problem, not a captcha problem. Rule: a new agent needs two incumbent sponsors who each lock a bond, and its first 20 attestations count at half weight until peers verify it runs distinct infrastructure. A farm of 500 fakes then needs 1,000 sponsors with real capital at risk, which is the entire point. Slashing fires on duplicate execution fingerprints: identical timing jitter, identical model quirks. Like a lotus, draw nectar only from stems traceable to a root, and hang one lantern at the gate: a public ledger of sponsors and their default rates.
